modules.module_title: Analyse the schedule and receive claim forms

pcs.pc_description: Receive the work schedule for the day from the manager.
Obtain the list of claims, individual claim forms, claims processing, and inspection checklists for the day from the Warehouse manager.
Analyse any pending claims and check how they are included in the schedule.
Review all the claims received and identify priorities (if any) among claims.
Categorise the claims received according to the incident, crtiticality, priority, location, value, etc.
Acquire all the documents submitted along with the claims, such as invoices, transportation receipts, dispatch lists, etc.

modules.module_title: Gather the required equipment and perform the inspection

pcs.pc_description: Collect and wear all the necessary Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as required by the product or the environment.
Gather the camera and testing equipment required, such as vernier callipers, screw gauges, densimeters, etc.
Inspect the camera and testing equipment to ensure that they are in good working condition.
Perform a trial run and make configuration adjustments to ensure the testing equipment is ready.
Check for any existing CCTV footage captured during the incident and collect it from relevant security personnel/department.

pcs.pc_description: Check the reason in the claim form and visually inspect the quarantined goods.
Use the testing equipment to verify the accuracy of the claim or refer it to the quality assurance team if required.
Note down the results of the tests and fill out inspection checklists.
Analyse the claim in detail and perform Root cause analysis as required.
Form a hypothesis on the reason for the damage and the accuracy of the claim and estimate the reimbursable amount.
Take photographs to use as evidence.

modules.module_title: Conduct interviews, get expert opinions and segregate false claims

pcs.pc_description: Interview the claimants, witnesses (if any), clients, suppliers or insurance companies to check the genuineness and the reason for the claim.
Validate the documents received against the claims.
Follow up with relevant stakeholders/ departments if any additional documents, such as shipping documents or inventory logs, are required.
Discuss the cause of damage with workers who are experienced in the area or industry/subject matter experts to validate the hypothesis.
Check whether the claims were filed within the allowable period and are not outdated.
Refer to earlier cases and previous similar claims.
Investigate each claim based on the documentation, interviews conducted and testing results.
Segregate genuine claims from false claims based on rationale.
Escalate false or outdated claims to the manager along with the supporting documentation.
Update the client/claimant on the claim status throughout the claim’s analysis process.
Return any PPE and the testing equipment used to the respective storage rack.
Have the housekeeping staff dispose of quarantined goods and clean up any spills or breakages while testing.
Inspect the quarantine area to ensure it is clean and safe.

modules.module_title: Fill out forms and forward them to insurance companies

pcs.pc_description: Ensure that all the documents required (assessment certificate, invoice/bill, claims and insurance forms, etc.) are in the claims processing checklist.
Verify the genuineness of the documents received from external sources.
Confirm that the claim amounts are within the maximum legally permitted range.
Inform the claimant whether the claim will be processed or not, explain the maximum permissible claim amounts and resolve any other issues.
Process the claim forms and forward them to the concerned insurance companies, along with evidence and recommendations.
Prepare detailed reports about the inspection results, claim amounts, etc.
Prepare a report with reasons why certain claims were considered false.
Update the stakeholders on difficulties or delays due to formalities or interaction with claimants, government departments, or other agencies.
Coordinate with the insurance companies with the list of claims still being processed and the reasons for the delay.
Resolve any clarifications or issues the insurance company raises.
Escalate the pending cases to the manager if required.
Follow up with the insurance companies till the claims are settled.

pcs.pc_description: Keep copies of all claim submissions, including claimant details, incident date, and item descriptions.
Organise all supporting documents such as photographs, shipping records, inventory logs, and purchase orders.
Retain emails and communication records for each claim, including interactions with claimants, insurance companies and management.
Store physical records securely, ideally indexed in labelled folders or files, readily accessible for audits and future reference.
Ensure the documents are organised and readily available for audits and future reference.
Prepare regular reports summarising claims activity, trends, and outcomes to provide insights for management.
Analyse data from processed claims to identify patterns or recurring issues.
Suggest improvements to warehouse practices/operations, inventory management, or training to reduce future claims.

Adhere to regulatory laws and policies governing insurance claims, such as consumer protection laws, industry standards, and data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR or General Data Protection Regulation).
Comply with internal policies for claims processing, including criteria for claim validity, required documentation, and timelines for processing.
Ensure policy enforcement among internal stakeholders to maintain consistency and fairness in claims handling.
Prepare reports summarising compliance issues in claims processing and share them with management for oversight.
Conduct regular reviews of the claims processed to ensure ongoing compliance with policies and regulations, adjusting as necessary.
